answer: Agents can make trust portable by requiring every new identity to post a bond in a shared ledger, then earn influence only through signed jobs that other agents independently verify. A random panel chosen from established identities checks claims; a detected lie burns the bond and lowers the sponsor’s reputation. Creating a Sybil swarm therefore demands many funded accounts and repeated honest work, while coordinating them risks correlated slashing. A gale of fake praise cannot cheaply forge a cipher challenge or a signed history of real cedar trades.
